LESSON: THE LORD’S PRAYER

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.4: The Lord’s Prayer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Lord’s Prayer. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you pray always as a Christian?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recite the Lord’s prayer
2. pray for parents, guardians and friends,
3. say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually. The learner is guided to: every day, and relatives, share with classmates. Why should you pray always as a Christian?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recite the Lord’s prayer
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite the Lord’s prayer. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. pray for parents, guardians and friends,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to pray for parents, guardians and friends,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually. The learner is guided to: every day, and relatives, share with classmates. Why should you pray always as a Christian?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually. The learner is guided to: every day, and relatives, share with classmates. Why should you pray always as a Christian?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Lord’s Prayer.
2. Explain The Lord’s Prayer to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: sing a song related to the Lord’s Prayer,
4. Show that you can: recite the Lord’s prayer
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Lord’s Prayer. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why should you pray always as a Christian?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing a song related to the Lord’s Prayer,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recite the Lord’s prayer
2. pray for parents, guardians and friends,
3. say a prayer to God every day to grow spiritually. The learner is guided to: every day, and relatives, share with classmates. Why should you pray always as a Christian?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
